summary: Cross-floor workstation move: badge mapping conflict, docking station return scheduling, and courier customs hold
description: Issue summary: Senior engineer relocating from Building B, Floor 4 to Building B, Floor 7. During access provisioning we found their badge mapping still points to the legacy desk and attempts to provision the new desk access are failing with a 403 mapping mismatch. Additionally, the engineer is returning a company docking station and a sealed NVMe SSD; the scheduled courier pickup (international) is on hold due to incomplete customs description for 'battery-attached' peripherals. Impact: Employee cannot access the new floor workstation cleanly and is using a temporary hoteling desk; potential security risk if old badge mapping not revoked; hardware return delayed beyond warranty return window. Location: Building B (Old Dockyard), Floors 4 -> 7. Steps already taken: 1) Facilities attempted badge reprovisioning via DoorDB (error: mapping conflict) 2) Security reviewed badge record and confirmed duplicate mapping entry for legacy-desk-0043 3) Inventory logged assets to be returned and opened international courier case 4) Shipping reported customs classification rejected because docking station box flagged as 'battery' without proper UN number. Required outcome: resolve badge mapping and confirm new DeskID assigned; schedule escorted access if needed; confirm courier customs paperwork and pickup time; confirm return logged and assets removed from user's inventory. Attachments/links: DoorDB ticket #5421, Inventory export CSV (attached in Jira), shipping case SHIP-9123.
steps_to_reproduce_or_recreate: 1) Attempt to assign DeskID B7-21 in DoorDB for user a.raman@redwood.com
3) Attempt to badge-scan at B7 secure turnstile; access denied (403)
4) Open shipping case and upload customs declaration PDF -> receive rejection from courier: 'incomplete battery classification'

2026-03-12 - Security (J. Patel): Door controller shows access group conflict; provisioning API throws 409 when attempting to attach new desk rule. Hypothesis: orphaned mapping record lives in legacy_table and DoorDB provisioning script only checks primary_table.

2026-03-12 - Shipping (L. González): courier requires battery declaration for docking stations when shipped internationally. Docking station model DS-77A contains a lithium battery in the adapter; shipping manifest must include UN3481 classification and pro-forma invoice value and country-of-origin.
2026-03-12 - Inventory (E. Torres): flagged SSD DLK-SSD-38012 as 'sealed', warranty-return ETA 2026-03-18; delay beyond this risks reduced RMA cover.
